_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Interim Training Development Package
summary: The Interim Training Development Package documents format and content preparation instructions for interim training materials needed to meet fleet training needs before formal follow-on training is established.
use_relationship:
The interim training development package is required to meet training needs prior to establishment of the formal follow-on training to ensure the fleet obtains training required on systems to meet operational commitments.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task required as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The interim training development package shall be presented in the contractors own format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The interim training development package shall contain a cover page specifying the system title.

children.title: The interim training development package shall contain the following sections:
Pre-test.
children.content: This section of the package shall contain, one question, for each terminal and enabling objective to be covered in the training; and an answer key.

children.title: Instructor guide.
children.content: This section shall include an introduction to the system and shall contain the following to be used by the instructor of the training:

children.title: Table of contents.
children.content: This section of the package shall include a list of all content sections of the interim training package.

children.title: Associated training time for each topic
Resources.
children.content: This section of the package shall identify the following to support training conduct:

children.title: Terminal Learning Objectives (TLO).
children.content: This section of the package shall include performance (behaviors), conditions, and standards for knowledge and skills the students must acquire to satisfactorily complete the topics presented.

children.title: Enabling Learning Objectives (ELO).
children.content: This section of the package shall include specific statements of behavior to be exhibited, the conditions under which they are to be exhibited, and the standard to which they shall be performed that support the TLO's.

children.title: Instructional Media.
children.content: This section of the package shall contain the presentation material that supports the TLO's and ELO's discussed.

children.title: References.
children.content: This section shall include all references used in the development of the package.

children.title: Post-test.
children.content: This section of the package shall contain:

children.title: A minimum of one test question for each TLO presented in the conduct of the training
Lab sheets identifying skills to be performed by the student in a lab/shipboard
Student guide.
children.content: This section of the package shall contain:

children.title: Detailed information on each TLO/ELO learning objective
Instructions for a task/learning activity that each student will perform
Student Critiques.
children.content: This section of the package shall contain:

preparation_instructions.title: Media requirement.
preparation_instructions.content: The electronic media requirement shall be Microsoft Office, version 2007-2010.
